info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Validation Service API
info.description: The Product Validation Service API facilitates the validation of products within the banking product management system. Through this endpoint, users can submit specific product parameters to ensure their compliance with required standards and regulations. This service is beneficial for financial institutions and product managers to streamline the onboarding of new products and mitigate risks associated with non-compliance. Typical use cases include validating new product offerings before launch or ensuring existing products meet updated regulatory requirements.
